title: The Plastic Men
overview: Vietnam veteran Jonathan Teller suffers from guilt and paranoid delusions. He decides to take his own life, but as he struggles to come to terms with his choice and reality, a chance encounter changes everything.

title: Do You Love Me
overview: A playful and personal journey through Lebanon’s audiovisual memory, composed entirely of archival footage. It is a love letter to Beirut, spanning 70 years of film, TV, home videos, and photography, exploring the Lebanese collective psyche – marked by joy and intimacy, destruction and loss. Through the eyes of citizens, filmmakers and artists, the film reconstructs a fragmented history in a country without a national archive, celebrating creative expression as both resistance, renewal and a way to preserve memory.

title: Corporate Retreat
overview: Blending the dread of survival horror with dark laughs and shocking twists, "Corporate Retreat" centers around a group of young executives whose luxury team-building trip descends into a bloody fight for survival against a vengeful retreat leader.

title: Swapped
overview: A small woodland creature and a majestic bird, two natural sworn enemies of the Valley, magically trade places and set off on an adventure of a lifetime to switch back. Their journey soon uncovers a greater threat—one that could endanger not only their species, but the entire valley they call home.

title: 剑来院线剧场版 十三之争
Patriot
overview: When a Malayali DRW analyst tries to expose a corrupt regional politician from Kerala and his malpractices regarding spyware, he goes on the run, becomes a vlogger, and must clear his name of the false allegations levelled against him.

title: Raja Shivaji
overview: Chronicles the rise of young Shivaji Bhonsale, who challenged the might of established empires to found the Maratha kingdom and lay the groundwork for 'Swarajya' (self-rule) during a turbulent period of Indian history.

title: Check-In
overview: VMX hottest star Aliya Raymundo teams up with sexy siren Anya Austria as two receptionists in a cheap motel. Their quiet routine heats up with the arrival of a mysterious regular guest who begins to stir tension, desire, and conflict in their fragile relationship.

title: Ek Din
overview: Dino is in love with his colleague Meera but lacks the courage to express his feelings. He finally gets his chance during the company trip. He makes a wish to be with Meera for just one day, and his wish comes true.

title: Casa Grande
overview: A prodigal daughter rejoins her family at their farm during a difficult time, as her ailing father faces both a terminal diagnosis and mounting pressure from competitors. Old wounds resurface as they grapple with what lies ahead.

title: Cold War 1994
overview: Flashback to 1994, before Hong Kong’s handover to China. As the Special Branch of the Royal Hong Kong Police Force prepares to disband, the kidnapping of a powerful business tycoon ignites a dangerous covert power struggle within the force. Caught in the conflict are two officers: the passionate and righteous M.B. Lee and the cold-blooded and ambitious Peter Choi. Four formidable factions — the city’s wealthiest family, the Poon’s, the police, the triads, and the British authorities — are drawn into a deadly vortex of ambition, betrayal, and hidden agendas. As old alliances fracture and new ones form, Hong Kong stands on the brink of a seismic power reshuffle that will cast a long shadow into the future.

title: One Spoon of Chocolate
overview: After serving his country in the Army, Unique is falsely accused of assault and sent to prison. Once released, Unique sets up shop in Ohio to restart his life, linking up with his only surviving relative, Ramsey. There’s something insidious happening in this town, though, as its racist sheriff and his crew of similarly bigoted acolytes all have a knack for violence and share a gruesome secret pertaining to a recent string of missing young Black men. When they set their sights on Unique and turn his life upside down, the former soldier has no choice but to bring the ruckus down on the sheriff and his goons.

title: Swallowed Star The Movie  - Battle on Primal Star
overview: During his training on the Original Star, Luo Feng faces constant threats from alien races coveting his strength and resources. Remaining calm and strategic, he uses both intelligence and power to counterattack and defend humanity’s honor. Wielding a formidable and beautiful battle blade, Luo Feng carves a path of destruction through his enemies, declaring, “I have a single strike that can sever the universe.”  As tensions escalate, the demon race, mechanical race, and insect race reappear and form a three-race alliance. Their leaders, along with 6,000 universe-level experts, join forces to encircle and eliminate Luo Feng. In the face of overwhelming odds, Luo Feng unleashes his ultimate technique, “I Am the Universe,” annihilating the coalition in one decisive strike.

title: The Box in the Attic
overview: After the death of her estranged mother, a troubled woman returns to her childhood home and discovers a box. When she breaks its seal, she unleashes malevolent entities tied to a dark family legacy and a deadly secret of her own.

title: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema
overview: Earl Clancy, a cinema owner on the edge, battles a series of disasters while juggling personal turmoil and the chaos of a packed Friday night crowd. Told in real time over the course of the movie playing in the cinema.

title: Jetlee
overview: An attendant on a flight from Dubai to Kochi gets caught up in a dangerous situation.

title: Pitt Siyapa
overview: Nimmi, a clever young woman, transforms her father's death into an unusual business running virtual funerals for NRIs. With her ragtag crew, she orchestrates chaotic send-offs until NRI Mickey arrives, sparking hilarious chaos and romance.

title: Gaayapadda Simham
overview: Follows Indians facing challenges while trying to travel to the USA and the struggles they encounter after reaching there.

title: Brimstone Terrace
overview: When a depressed public defender ends his own life, he is sentenced to an eternity in Hell. However, after Satan takes notice of his skills, he is offered an afterlife-changing deal that may not fall in line with his own values.

title: Vanishing Point
overview: On the morning of the winter solstice, Tang Yu's son disappeared in the stairwell; gambler Yuan Wu hid his father's body; and two unsolved cases involving the assault.

title: Dhabkaaro
overview: An extremely inhuman, cruel, rude, and dishonest man named Ashok Patel embarks on a quest for forgiveness to reconcile with his past.

title: Жертва на гнева
overview: An elite special forces operative is sent by Russian Intelligence to hunt down former teammates who have hijacked nuclear warheads.

title: Straight Guy Watches Gay Porn for the First Time
overview: When Janek, a straight Polish guy watches gay porn for the first time, his world is turned upside down. Battling with unsettling new thoughts, he is put into a journey of self-discovery.

title: You, Always
overview: Ethan is a devoted best friend who soon realises he has long been in love with Dr Jen Bell. However, Jen’s world is turned upside down by the arrival of a charismatic author named Patrick.

title: Infestation
overview: Jason, a man burdened with the care of his abusive, dementia ridden mother, takes a job as an exterminator. He steals something from his client, who turns out to be a witch, and suffers the consequences.

title: Fire, Water, Earth, Air
overview: Four stories from the Nordic region paint a picture of a changing natural world, where the elements rage and where being prepared proves to be much more than sandbags and fire extinguishers.

title: 猪猪侠大电影之竞速小英雄
No One is Closer Than We
overview: When Li Weiyang's motorcycle crash left his girlfriend with missing front teeth, he struggled to afford implants by negotiating with the at-fault driver and insurers, upending their modest but stable life.

title: Lone Star Bull
overview: Bull Jackson is a bouncer in a gay bar where Jordan performs as a drag queen by night and is a medical student by day. When Coco, their mentor and owner of the club, is shot in what appears to be a random homophobic attack, Bull and Jordan form an unlikely team to find those responsible.

title: Mantra Muugdha
overview: A magical, musical, maddening ride where the music will unleash a thrilling adventure of a lifetime.

title: Carefree Head
overview: Murat, who lives in Istanbul, decides to return to his hometown of Cappadocia after being fired from his job. As he plans to start a new business there, his path crosses with his cousins Bedri and Fehmi, who are trying to escape the consequences of a crime they committed. However, the carefree spirit wandering around the town will both prevent Bedri and Fehmi from escaping and support Murat in establishing his new venture.

title: Hostage
overview: When a routine cleanup goes wrong, three lifelong friends working for a ruthless crime syndicate must outwit their own boss after realizing they've accidentally killed the one man they were ordered to keep alive.

title: Kentucky Roses
overview: Kentucky Roses follows Sadie, a Churchill Downs greenhouse worker dreaming of designing the iconic Kentucky Derby rose garland, and Ash, the son of the track's CEO who is trying to hide his identity to prove his own worth.** When a storm damages the venue two weeks before the big race, the pair must team up to repair the iconic Twin Spires and save the traditional rose blanket. Along the way, they discover a 1932 connection between their families whose romance was torn apart by class differences, forcing them to navigate past history to find their own future together.

title: Todo Mundo no Rio com Shakira
overview: On the iconic sands of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, Shakira sets Copacabana Beach ablaze in the third edition of “Todo Mundo no Rio”. Before a historic crowd of 2 million people, the Colombian superstar celebrates three decades of hits in an electrifying performance that bridges her new album, “Las Mujeres Ya No Lloran,” with the timeless classics that defined her career. Featuring guest appearances by Brazilian music icons and a high-tech visual spectacle, the night transforms the coastline into the stage for an epic celebration of power, music, and the artist’s unbreakable connection with Brazil.

title: Time of Plenty
overview: Time of Plenty is an essayistic documentary about man-made climate change, Easter Island, and our place in the universe.  Written and directed by Robin Jensen  Narrated by Renate Reinsve  Produced by Mikrofilm AS

title: Emi Martínez: The Kid Who Stops Time
overview: Mixing animation and interviews, this film follows Emi Martínez's journey to becoming a legendary goalkeeper, from small-town Argentina to world glory.

title: Fletcher Street
overview: The joy and sense of freedom of North Philadelphia at risk youth as they ride horses majestically through the streets of their neighbourhood is as affirming as the trust, discipline and emotional resilience they build through their close bonds with the horses.

title: The Cutting Room
overview: A film student attempts to cut corners the night before an assignment is due.

title: Purgatory: Zone of Murderers
overview: In the near future of South Korea, where it became lawless due to an economic crisis, a new authoritarian government implements the “Permanent Exile Law” to easily control the country. According to this law, death row inmates are permanently exiled to a detention center, the Purgatory, built in abandoned nuclear power plants. With a degree of self-governance granted by the government, the Purgatory gradually reaches a point where it is beyond external control, leaving the government struggling to find a solution. Yu-seong, a police officer who became a death row inmate due to the revenge for his daughter and wife, is offered a deal by the Director of NIS. Now Yu-seong must eliminate the Purgatory Boss, the king of the center, in exchange for possible pardon.

title: The Narcissist's Playbook
overview: Five-country documentary with four self-aware malignant narcissists exposing their manipulation methods, victim accounts, and expert analysis of narcissistic abuse patterns to help viewers identify and defend against such behavior.

title: Understanding Myself as an Amphibian
overview: This queer ecology documentary explores the sexual diversity of the wildlife around us. Director May Matchim draws connections between these incredible species and her own journey accepting her Transness. The title is a reference to the green frog, an amphibian which is able to change its sex as it matures.  This film includes a variety of animal and plant subjects, including same-sex bird parents raising chicks together, and a group of salamanders that's entirely female. It also examines the exclusionary attitudes in biology and conservation throughout time, and how these attitudes have influenced our understanding of animal behaviour.

title: 英皇娱乐25周年群星演唱会
Exodus
overview: EXODUS is a gritty post-apocalyptic short film about survival, loss, and how far a young man can be pushed before he loses himself.

title: A Weapon in My Heart
overview: A detective and his partner track down a call girl with information about a drug cartel. After taking her into custody, they are attacked by cartel members. The detective and the woman manage to escape, but they are soon hounded by a professional hitman hired to eliminate them and recover the heroin stolen by the woman.

title: Gary
overview: Two friends go on a work trip and encounter unexpected challenges and local personalities as they navigate their assignment. Their efforts to adapt to unfamiliar surroundings highlights moments of humor, small-town culture and the unpredictable nature of work travel. As they troubleshoot problems, their experience leaves a lasting impression and offers new perspectives on their friendship.

title: Pasakalye
overview: Brotherhood versus Duty. Two childhood friends will have the greatest ride of their lives as they find themselves up against each other. Who will rule the streets?

title: Despondency
overview: A high school girl drifts through the same quiet routine every day. As time passes, her world grows smaller and more isolated, revealing the weight of her depression. Struggling with loneliness, she finds herself stuck in a cycle that makes each day feel the same as the last.

title: Taco Tuesday
overview: A suburban housewife embarks on a dangerous mission to rescue her captured husband so he isn't late for dinner.

title: Good Vibes Only
overview: Based on the true story of a married couple who invented a groundbreaking sex toy heralded as forever changing the way women experience pleasure.

title: Almost Us
overview: RR has always been in love with his best friend, Janine. But she's infatuated with Kenzo, the star of her own fan fiction. When he finds a way for Janine to meet Kenzo, will he risk his own happiness just for her to have her own happiness?

title: What is Love?
overview: Marguerite has no reason to refuse the church’s annulment of her marriage to Fred. She also has a new partner with whom she has a child. However, to convince the church that their previous marriage was doomed from the start, Marguerite and Fred must examine their shared past.

title: The Day She Returns
overview: She has just finished the shoot of an independent film and now has to give three interviews about it. Afterwards, in her acting class, her teacher asks her to reenact the interviews. But for some reason, she is unable to remember them.

title: Mi Amor
overview: Romy is a French DJ touring the sun-bleached and club-lit Canary Islands, until her friend vanishes. Met with evasion from locals and the authorities, her search leads her to a magnetic stranger and the sinister proprietors of an exotic animal sanctuary.

title: Collapse
overview: Shortly after October 7th 2023, Anat returns to what was once her home, wandering for over two years through a burned-down kibbutz and agricultural lands turned into fields of machines of destruction. Beyond the fence, Gaza is annihilated.

title: Countdown: Rousey vs. Carano
overview: Hit training camp with MMA legends Ronda Rousey and Gina Carano before they return to the cage on May 16 for their must-see fight that’s been years in the making. Countdown: Rousey vs. Carano is narrated by Uma Thurman and directed by Tim Mullen & Jackie Decker.

title: Mortal Kombat II
overview: The fan favorite champions—now joined by Johnny Cage himself—are pitted against one another in the ultimate, no-holds barred, gory battle to defeat the dark rule of Shao Kahn that threatens the very existence of the Earthrealm and its defenders.

title: My Dearest Assassin
overview: Hunted for her rare blood type, a caged woman vows to fight alongside the assassin she loves to protect their future when an old enemy resurfaces.

title: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
overview: With unprecedented access to the official archives and intimate recollections from the band, both current and past,  Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition invites fans to experience one of the most iconic journeys in music history.  Spanning five decades, this electrifying documentary charts the band’s rise from the pubs of East London to the world’s biggest stadiums. Featuring exclusive interviews with band members and contributors such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich and Chuck D, as well as all-new animated sequences of the band's legendary mascot, Eddie, the film offers a rare and intimate look at Iron Maiden’s uncompromising vision and unwavering connection with their truly global army of fans.

title: Krishnavataram Part 1: The Heart (Hridayam)
overview: An epic devotional narrative that reimagines the journey of Lord Krishna, tracing his path from Dwarka to Kurukshetra after parting ways with Radha. As his journey unfolds, it explores his connection with people, his layered personality, and the lessons he imparts about love and life.

title: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
overview: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.

title: Desire
overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

title: Tarung: Unforgiven
overview: After unintentionally causing the death of his opponent during a martial arts tournament, Hatta vows to never participate in any fighting tournament again. However, when his only sister becomes seriously ill and requires costly medical treatment, he is offered 'financial assistance' by a head of mobsters in return for Hatta fighting for him in the underworld fighting ring.

title: USA 94: Brazil's Return to Glory
overview: Follows Brazil's journey to winning its fourth World Cup in 1994, featuring interviews with players and unseen behind-the-scenes footage from the tournament.

title: A Fading Man
overview: When her ex-husband reappears, now suffering from dementia and having forgotten their divorce, Hanne’s orderly life with partner Bernd is gently upended.

title: Copán: The Legend
overview: In the heart of the Honduran jungle lies the ancient city of Copan, cradle of the Mayan civilization and the unexpected setting for the redemption of Roberto Papa Agurcia.

title: Shaka Oh Shaka
overview: A meeting at a concert changes everything. Ocel, a simple college student, never expected to become the lover of her idol, Shaka. Their closeness, which began with admiration, blossomed into a mutually reinforcing love. However, their relationship was tested by the realities of life and the swift currents of time. Will they survive, or will they find their way through separation?

title: Tekenchu: The Rite of the Nahuales
overview: A federal agent is investigating a complex case: a series of chilling infanticides in which the victims’ teeth have been extracted; meanwhile, in a nearby village, two healers find a wounded man in the woods and offer him refuge.

title: Roya
overview: Roya, an Iranian teacher imprisoned in Tehran’s Evin Prison for her political beliefs, is faced with a choice: make a forced televised confession or remain confined to her three-square-metre cell. As past and present slip out of sequence and exchange places, she moves between inner landscapes and lived experience.

title: Shurale
overview: Aysha is preparing for the wedding, but suddenly learns that her brother Timur has disappeared. In search of her brother, the girl returns to her native village, where she encounters not only her own past, but also a secret hidden in the depths of the forest.

title: Illusione
overview: Perugia. The police are carrying away the body of a young woman when they hear a sigh: Rosa Lazar is still alive. The assistant district attorney Cristina Camponeschi and psychologist Stefano Mangiaboschi investigate, but Rosa seems unaware of the attack she has endured and hides the truth. For Cristina, the girl is the key to an international crime ring; for Stefano, the start of an inner journey that will lead him to reveal the true enigma of Rosa Lazar.

title: Eclipse
overview: Cleo, a 43-year-old astronomer who is pregnant and emotionally fragile, is surprised by a visit from Nalu, her half-sister of Indigenous descent. The encounter reveals dark secrets and stirs up fragmented memories in Cleo, leading the two of them down a path of mysterious investigations.

title: The Father
overview: The action takes place during the Great Patriotic War. The protagonist, a Siberian hunter Gavriil Sobinov, volunteers for the front after learning that his son Semyon, a young lieutenant, is missing. Gavriil wants to fights the enemy and find his son, but instead of the front lines, he finds himself in a supply platoon. He proves himself a hero in his very first combat and, after training at the sniper school, gets to the front lines. Gavriil is made commander of the sniper group. He continues the search for his son. The story of a German sniper Werner develops in parallel. He also ends up at the front with his son Dietrich fighting alongside him. A clash between the sniper fathers, whom fate is inexorably bringing together, is inevitable...

title: Remission
overview: In the empty corridors of her abandoned Catholic school, a woman must confront the grief of a first love lost too soon, face the truth she has long avoided, and finally learn to forgive herself.

title: Halcyon Days
overview: A troubled actor returns home to visit his ailing mother, only to discover his life has inexplicably turned into a sitcom.

title: M4M: Motive for Murder
overview: Hyderabad is on edge as a serial killer stages murders as famous paintings. ACP Krishna and journalist Radha investigate, uncovering links to a student and a principal, racing to stop the next planned killing.

title: ARCHAEOLOGY OF UNBORN FACES
overview: "Archaeology of Unborn Faces" is a silent cinematic excavation of the AI latent space. It stands before a digital purgatory, witnessing the agonizing struggle of algorithms trying to manifest into human form. In an epoch drowning in simulation, the film reveals that the machine creates nothing from the void, but rather recycles our abandoned memories, culminating in a terrifying emotional resonance.

title: Dridam
overview: A police officer arrives at a seemingly peaceful station but faces pressure when human remains are discovered. Given only a week to solve the murder, he must navigate demands from his department and an anxious public seeking swift justice.

title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
overview: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

A quirky 29-year-old named Sathya embarks on an unexpected journey of laughter, unlikely friendships, and self-discovery. Through hilarious misadventures and chance encounters, he slowly sees life's bigger picture - its surprises, joys, and second chances.

title: Blue Film
overview: Drawn by the promise of easy money and anonymous sex, queer camboy Aaron Eagle is shocked to discover a personal connection with the mysterious stranger who has paid for his company. Over the course of one night, the two men engage in a war of words and emotions as they wrestle with the impact of a tainted and shared past.

title: Broad Trip
overview: When buttoned-up daughter Alice plans a “bachelorette” road trip with her wild and impulsive mother, Jeanie, to talk her out of marrying a guy she just met, they rediscover their unbreakable bond, confronting old wounds and old flames, while learning the lesson that sometimes life doesn’t follow a plan — and maybe that’s okay.

title: No Place to Be Single
overview: A brilliant and intelligent love comedy that celebrates second chances and new horizons, starring a strong and determined woman who settles the score.

title: Love Live! Hasunosora Girls' High School Idol Club Bloom Garden Party
Scissors
overview: Thrilling GL story about Karina who reinvents herself and finds love with a charming hairdresser after a heartbreak caused by a cheating boyfriend. But when her ex returns, she is forced to choose between a familiar past and freedom.

title: Sathi Leelavathi
overview: Leelavathi is a successful and spirited film director whose marriage with Ram Sethu begins falling apart. The relationship is strained by ego, changing gender roles, and the husband feeling overshadowed by his wife's success. Things complicate further when Sethu asks for a divorce and admits he has feelings for another woman, Nicola Sebastian. The couple is then forced to confront unresolved feelings and unearth hidden truths about their marriage.

title: Neglected
overview: Detective Shaw is about to retire when he finds out on his last day of work that a serial killer has buried his son alive. He then races against the clock to solve three murders and find his son’s location before he runs out of air.

title: Affection
overview: Afflicted by a mysterious condition that resets her memory, Ellie becomes trapped in a cyclical nightmare with a man who claims to be her husband. She soon must uncover the horrifying truth of her existence—before she forgets it all again.

title: Daadi Ki Shaadi
overview: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.

title: Godari Gattupaina
overview: In the picturesque Godavari villages, a kind-hearted auto driver and a spirited college girl fall in love, but their bond is tested by her father's expectations and unforeseen challenges.

title: The Irregular at Magic High School THE MOVIE - Yotsuba Succession Arc -
overview: The invitation has arrived. It's time for the New Year's Reception at the Yotsuba family residence. This year, Miyuki and other candidates will gather there to decide who will be the next leader of their powerful clan. If chosen as successor, she would never again have to see her brother live as an outcast. At the same time, such a position would surely entail a political marriage, leaving her mind in complete turmoil. To complicate matters, the current head of the family sows doubt with a shocking statement. When the new year arrives, their relationship may change forever...

title: The Red Hangar
overview: Chile, 1973. The military coup will force Jorge Silva, an Air Force captain, to face the unfolding horror. Inside a military base, he must choose between becoming part of the repression or helping those fighting to stay alive.

title: Influenced
overview: Renowned influencer Dzanielle navigates fake friends among the black card-swiping, Ozempic-sharting, workout-addicted Upper East Siders. In her comedic quest for a million followers, she finds her first real new friend and her true self.

title: At the Place of Ghosts
overview: Haunted by the past, siblings Mise’l and Antle are destined to reunite and join forces against a dark spirit that emerges from their shared childhood. Once inseparable, their fractured relationship set by years of silence and a violent episode rooted in homophobia, is tested as they must return to Sk+te’kmujue’kati (the Place of Ghosts) a forest steeped in ancestral memory where time bends. What initiates from trauma soon transforms into an odyssey of healing, as Mise’l and Antle confront their caretaker’s cruelty, the weight of family secrets, and their own deepest fears.

title: My Royal Nemesis
overview: A legendary villain from the Joseon era is reincarnated in the body of a struggling modern actress and clashes with a cold, calculating chaebol heir, igniting an intense love-hate romance that transcends centuries.

title: The Great Money Robbery
overview: Pushed by betrayal, bullying, and desperation, Wu Xiaobao is drawn into an armed bank robbery and slowly descends into a dark, irreversible path.

title: Sleeping Dog
overview: Investigative journalist Jeremy Corbell emerges as a key figure in a dangerous fight to uncover the truth about UAPs, driven by rare access and knowledge few possess. As his pursuit deepens, so do the risks of exposing what was never meant to be seen.

title: Black Holes Suck
overview: After cracking his formula for unlimited energy, Cal, a lonely genius unknowingly agrees to a date with an Alien who's true motives lies in obtaining his formula before it can be used to wreak havoc amongst the Stars

title: Couples Weekend
overview: What happens when a tree falls in the woods and someone does hear it? Two couples are forced to deal with such a question — and their lives in general — when a New Year's Eve trip to the woods unearths simmering feelings and the secrets they carry threaten to break their seemingly perfect relationships.

title: Nightmare Hospital
overview: A horror film about a pilot who is the sole survivor of the plane crash in the deep unknown. He must survive in an isolated building where something evil is waiting.

title: David Attenborough's 100 Years on Planet Earth
overview: A 90-minute special, broadcast from the Royal Albert Hall, London, celebrating Sir David Attenborough's groundbreaking career on the day of his 100th birthday.

title: Yo no moriré de amor
overview: At 18, Claudia doesn't want to be a hero. Her mother's illness erupts like a silent storm, forcing a redefinition of roles in a family long estranged. Torn between the duty to care for her mother and the desire to live like any other girl her age, Claudia searches for a way to navigate this new reality, which will transform the bonds between the entire family.

title: Indian Institute of Zombies
overview: At an elite engineering campus, students must survive a sudden zombie outbreak while navigating academic pressures and social hierarchies, blending horror with comedy and biting satire of privilege and competition.

title: TRAD
overview: From their home in the Donegal Gaeltacht, gifted fiddle player Shóna McAnally and her little brother Mickey take to the road with a troupe of wandering musicians, on a cross-country journey of adventure, romance, and musical exploration.

title: The Misconceived
overview: A failed filmmaker turned single dad tries to make a living while retaining his sense of self, in James N. Kienitz Wilkins’ experimental 3D-rendered home renovation comedy, which doubles as an acidic treatise on working conditions for the contemporary creative.

title: Little Lamb
overview: After her parents' death, Lily moves into the vacation home they left for her and discovers she's far from alone.

title: Variations on a Theme
overview: An elderly goat herder falls victim to a scam promising long-awaited reparations for her father's WWII service. Structured as a series of recurring visual 'variations', Variations on a Theme is a portrait of endurance and loss.

title: Poca Pon
overview: Inspired by a bizarre murder case, this is the story of a family and the voice "POCA PON" — a voice that sometimes heals people, and sometimes destroys them.

title: Amalgam
overview: Helen is a visual artist who isolates herself in a house to prepare for a new artistic project. Her solitude is disrupted when her wife, Angela, returns from a trip. However, Helen begins to experience hallucinations and growing paranoia, leading her to question whether the woman in her house is truly Angela or an imposter.

title: I'm Not An Actor
overview: A frustrated actor in Mumbai connects with a retired banker in Frankfurt through an online audition and ends up teaching him acting over video calls. Their sessions unfold across two cities, pushing both to confront buried emotions and truths they have long avoided.

title: Another Man's Wife
overview: A millionaire makes a shocking offer to a married couple in crisis, who are financially devastated and caring for a terminally ill parent. What begins as an act of survival spirals into a high-stakes emotional reckoning about trust, love and the ultimate cost of sacrifice.

title: The Python Hunt
overview: Every year, the Florida government invites the general public to compete in an invasive python removal contest in the Everglades. For ten nights, an eclectic group of hunters confront the dangerous terrain, nocturnal creatures and their own desires.

title: Kyoto Hippocrates
overview: In the late Edo period, when traditional Chinese medicine (Kampo) was mainstream, a Dutch-style Western doctor, Taikichi, devoted himself to treating poor villagers. After saving the life of a rough young man, Shinzaburō, through surgery, the man turned his life around and began training to become a doctor himself. Fifteen years later, having studied the latest medical science in Nagasaki, Shinzaburō returns and joins Taikichi in confronting a suspected outbreak of typhoid fever. Set against the backdrop of a time when Kampo and Western medicine competed for legitimacy, this moving historical drama follows the struggles of doctors who risked everything to save lives during Japan’s medical awakening.

title: Cry Out
overview: Akiko, a girl living a hard life after her father passes away and her mother's new boyfriend turns abusive, starts receiving encouraging letters from her 30-year-old-future self. Akiko also starts to get bullied in school, and her teacher Shinomiya tries to help her, but ends up losing her job. Akiko also unearths a story written to her by her father, telling her how he originally met her mother, who was the abused daughter of a politician.

title: Suffs
overview: Created by Tony Award winner Shaina Taub, this musical recorded from Broadway tells the story of the American suffragist movement and the remarkable friendships, heartbreak, and action that brought women together—or, in some cases, tore them apart. The ensemble cast features Taub as Alice Paul, Tony winner Nikki M. James as Ida B. Wells, Tony nominee Jenn Colella as Carrie Chapman Catt, and Grace McLean as President Woodrow Wilson.

title: Mera Lyari
overview: A story resilience, identity and the courage to rise, even when the odds are stacked against you.

title: Jawaak
overview: Set against a community backdrop, events unfold around personal conflict and shifting relationships. As tensions rise, individuals are forced to confront difficult choices. The outcome is shaped by loyalty, pressure, and consequence.

title: Takeover
overview: Guy Miller is on parolee and trying to rehabilitate his life, but circumstances bring him back to the dangerous Atlanta. And he must live up to his reputation as one of the slickest street operators in a deadly race against the clock.

title: Love, Again
overview: Caroline and Henry's 30-year marriage faces upheaval when he's diagnosed with early-onset Alzheimer's. As Henry's memory deteriorates, Caroline finds comfort in friendship with Leo while coping with losing her partner.

title: The Good Assassin
overview: A naive contract killer becomes the roommate of his apathetic target, who he must find the strength to dispose of by the end of the week or face the wrath of the highest authorities of the criminal underworld.

title: Devil's Game
overview: When Michael's fiancée uses a Ouija board to manipulate his grief and create terrifying events, he must uncover her web of lies and deceit before her sinister game drives him to madness.

title: Mountain King
overview: When Hannah travels to Sweden to surprise her boyfriend and meet his parents, she begins to suspect that his family is hiding a monstrous secret.

title: The Feast of the Wolf
overview: The wolves are returning to a barren region in the Croatian-Dalmatian hinterland. Though the tourist destinations of the Adriatic coast are less than half an hour away, people in the deserted villages of Bukovica believe that "Brussels" represents evil and flies the wolves over by helicopter. Ana, a dedicated veterinarian, attempts to refute these theories and engage with the people on the ground.

title: Shift
overview: A girl, a group of hunters, and an otherworldly creature all cross paths over the course of one Hellish night

title: Thieves Highway
overview: After discovering a plot to haul stolen cattle in the middle of nowhere, a desperate and isolated lawman becomes the only thing standing between a group of dangerous rustlers and a clear run to the border.

title: The Roast of Kevin Hart
overview: Kevin Hart is in the hot seat and ready for all the smoke as roastmaster Shane Gillis and a dais of A-listers unleash a raw and ruthless night of laughs.

title: Mulan: Light A fire
overview: After returning home from war, Mulan discovers her family shattered by corruption and violence. As she investigates the truth behind her brother’s death, she uncovers a vast conspiracy involving corrupt officials and ruthless merchants, forcing her onto a solitary path of vengeance and justice.

title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier
overview: A plastic-spoon man is on his way to becoming a legendary army cook—uncovering dark secrets within the base through his cooking skills.

title: England 2006: The Golden Generation
overview: Documentary that explores why the men's England football team did not fulfil their potential at the 2006 World Cup, including insight and reflection from key members of the 'Golden Generation'.

title: Again Again
overview: After reliving the same day over and over again for 10 years, Agatha awakens to realize she's escaped and now faces the horrifying reality of a brand new day.

title: The Punisher: One Last Kill
overview: As Frank Castle searches for meaning beyond revenge, an unexpected force pulls him back into the fight.

title: Marty, Life Is Short
overview: Martin Short looks back on a life fueled by joy in this documentary with classic clips, fresh interviews and star-studded, never-before-seen home movies.

title: La Vénus électrique
overview: Artist Antoine has lost all inspiration and slipped into alcoholism since the death of his wife Irène, a loss he blames himself for. Suzanne is a penniless sideshow performer pretending to be a clairvoyant, whom Antoine consults in a bid to connect with Irène. Antoine’s dealer Armand, desperate to keep Antoine from falling apart, urges Suzanne to keep the ruse alive. She stages a series of improvised hypnosis sessions, claiming she can channel Irène in exchange for having her debts paid by Armand.

title: Jamie Vardy
overview: From part-time footballer to Premier League legend, this is the story of Jamie Vardy's unprecedented path and his rise to the top against all odds.

title: Zanni
overview: A period drama set between Scotland and Italy.

title: Amityville Rex
overview: The Amityville curse goes prehistoric. A dinosaur is resurrected and demonically possessed, unleashing a new terror on Amityville. A priest, a cop, and a criminal fugitive come together to exorcise the dino and stop the carnage.

title: They Wait in Shadows
overview: Two sisters returning to their family home after their mother's death, only to confront the monsters they accidentally conjured with a Ouija board.

title: Tenacity Girl
overview: A closed off young woman finds herself alone in her evacuated town, pondering the impending end of the world.

title: HOME MOVIES
overview: A compilation of recordings made between two friends in 2018.

title: Muppet Treasure Scriptland
overview: The Muppet Script returns to bring you MUPPET TREASURE SCRIPTLAND! When most people think of the Muppets, they think of the colorful characters made out of fleece and foam. But as with every movie, it all starts on the written page. And before returning to the big screen, the Muppets team returned to the writers' room. Another literary classic was turned on its head when Muppets scribe JERRY JUHL skewered ROBERT LOUIS STEVENSON'S tale of nautical adventure, joined this time by KIRK THATCHER and JAMES V. HART, and directed once again by JIM HENSON'S son, BRIAN HENSON. This performance will be a treasure worth its weight in gold!

title: Tumbal Proyek
overview: In the midst of a major bridge project connecting two regions, life after life is lost during its construction. Yuda, along with his sister and mother, infiltrates the construction company where their father was killed to prove that the project's sacrificer are real.

title: Teaching Practice: Idiot Girls and School Ghost 2
overview: Student teacher Kang Eun-kyung encounters a group of girls in a black magic club who are topping the national mock exams.

title: Forsaken
overview: Everyone knows the name of Samuel Paty, but few people really know his story. On October 16, 2020, Samuel Paty, professor of History-Geography, was murdered at the end of his college. In the light of investigations and trials, this film looks back on his last eleven days, and the gear that led to his tragic death.

title: Asad
overview: A slave in 19th Century Egypt revolts against his masters for equal rights for slaves to live freely.

title: Yang Lain Boleh Hilang Asal Kau Jangan
overview: Kesha, a final-year film student, lives in a warm family with her mother who also her beloved teacher, Yuke. However, their lives change when Yuke begins to experience increasingly severe memory loss. Amidst this, Kesha is faced with a major dilemma, continue pursuing her dreams or return home to avoid missing out on moments with her mother before it's too late.

title: Midnight Girls
overview: Set in Nagoya, Japan, four Filipina entertainers form a sisterhood while facing the emotional cost of their jobs. Together, they must decide what they are truly willing to sacrifice for their dreams in a foreign land.

title: Semua Akan Baik-Baik Saja
overview: Mentari's death forces the estranged siblings to reunite under Langit's care. Amidst their respective conflicts and wounds, they learn to accept their loss and rediscover the meaning of family.

title: Groundswell
overview: Viewers travel around the world, getting a global perspective on the three biggest (and interrelated) problems our species faces – climate change, species loss and soil loss. More importantly, viewers will learn about the multitude of methods in which regeneration is addressing and even reversing these trends on an ecosystem-by-ecosystem basis, all while storing enough carbon in the ground to help mitigate our changing climate.

title: The Bus: A French Football Mutiny
overview: This documentary revisits the French football team's controversial 2010 World Cup and the bus strike that sparked global headlines and national outrage.

title: Wrangler
overview: Hayoung, a successful dog trainer, is visited by her sister, Sora, who has a criminal record for murder. As Sora's bizarre behavior unsettles the training center and Hayoung's daily routine, buried truths and repressed desires start to rise to the surface.

title: What is the matter?
overview: Four couples. One night that was supposed to be perfect… but everything turned into chaos. Between expectations, pressure, and inexperience, every story takes an unexpected turn. Awkward situations, wrong decisions, and endless disasters…

title: Snail Mail
overview: A snail embarks on a long journey to deliver the mail.

title: LVLS Agituoja
overview: The LVLS Party invites you to vote

title: Obsession
overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

title: Karuppu
overview: In a world where justice falters, guardian deity Vettai Karuppu takes the guise of a lawyer to battle a corrupt legal system preying on the powerless.

title: In the Grey
overview: A covert team of elite operatives are living in the shadows. When a ruthless despot steals a billion-dollar fortune, they're sent to take it back—an impossible heist that erupts into a deadly game of strategy, deception and survival.

title: Hellfire
overview: A drifter with a mysterious past arrives in a small town and finds the residents in the grip of a ruthless crime boss and realizes he has to help them.

title: Kattalan
overview: Power-hungry forces clash in the Ivory cartel war-a fierce story of control, vengeance, and survival where compassion vanishes and only the ruthless endure.

title: Is God Is
overview: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths.

title: Athiradi
overview: Energetic student Samkutty revives a banned college festival, igniting a fierce rivalry that transforms celebration into chaos.

title: Driver's Ed
overview: A group of teens hit the road in a stolen driver's ed car, racing against time to help a lovesick high school senior track down his college-freshman girlfriend and win her back.

title: Anjali
overview: A man's emotional & psychological breakdown caused by a toxic relationship descends into chaos, panic, and mayhem when every attempt to end it fails.

title: The Cowboy
overview: Ten years in the life of young cowboy Crowley as he comes of age in the vastness of Colorado. On his rocky path, he endures loss, separation, and shattered dreams.

title: Ein Münchner im Himmel - Der Tod ist erst der Anfang
overview: When cab driver Ludwig “Wiggerl” Brunner, a true Munich bon vivant, is hit by a streetcar and ends up in heaven, there is only one way back to his beloved Bavaria: he has to improve his karma balance as quickly as possible.

title: Conni and the Mystery of the Crane
overview: While her parents are traveling, Conni experiences an exciting adventure at home with cat Mau, her friends, Grandpa Willi, a stuffy neighbor – and an injured crane, who urgently needs help. Will Conni and her friends manage to get crane Klaus to fly south with the migrating birds in time?

title: Mommy Down to the Ride
overview: A strict physics teacher tries to talk her teenage son out of dropping out of school and becoming a professional skateboarder. She makes a bet with him that if she competes in a major skateboarding competition, he will stay in school. Under the tutorship of one of her poorest pupils, she learns to skate, unaware that she's putting her career and reputation at stake.

title: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
overview: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.

title: Antartica - Quasi una fiaba
overview: A small group of scientists, unreachable for eight months, explores the future of humanity. Maria Medri, a foreign genius, arrives in Antarctica, challenging Fulvio Cadorna's plans. They are similar but conflicting, as everyone desires their own. This scientific, ideological, and emotional conflict unfolds.

title: Tangles
overview: When Alzheimer's disease begins to strip away her mother's vibrant personality, a headstrong young woman is forced to return to her oddball family in the conservative small town she recently fled in order to care for her. She quickly realizes she must accept the cruel and warped reality of the disease, and the imperfect beauty of her family, in order to become the daughter they need.

title: Don't Leave the Kids Alone
overview: A mother moves into a new house with her two children. One night she must leave the siblings home alone. What begins as a blast of carefree play soon turns into a claustrophobic horror story.

title: Monkey’s Magic Merry Go Round
overview: After a mysterious bout of amnesia, a beloved children’s television host struggles to piece together his fractured memories, only to find his once-cheerful puppet co-stars behaving with sinister intent. As reality unravels, the line between performance and nightmare begins to blur.

title: EB
overview: An ambitious ecologist returning to her childhood home on the Dutch island of Ameland discovers a dangerous drug smuggling route, forcing her to choose between exposing the truth and protecting those she loves.

title: Leo and Tig. The Road to Baikal
overview: Leo and Tig set off on a journey to faraway Lake Baikal to bring back home the lost seal pup named Lufi. Along the way, they make new friends with Zhu, a red panda, and Wukong the Monkey King. They also cross paths with the evil chieftain of a horse herd Tengri-Khan, who wants to seize the seal. For whoever brings Lufi home will be granted any wish by the Master of Baikal – the great dragon Lusud.

title: The Lunch: A Letter to America
overview: Eduardo, a Mexican cook in a Coney Island diner who crossed the desert two decades ago, becomes the unsuspecting centre of a story unfolding during the last week of the U.S. presidential campaign. Around him swirl fleeting encounters, patriotic hymns, prayers, accidental violence, tenderness, and landscapes of desperate beauty – an America at once raw and poetic.

title: Sacred Way, 21 km
overview: The Sacred Way of Athens, once a path of initiation into the Eleusinian Mysteries, prompts the director to search for spiritual meaning along the busy motorway it has now become. Following the traces of the ancient route, the diverse landscape and brief encounters with its current inhabitants reveal the different faces of the world’s oldest Sacred Way.

title: A Colisão dos Destinos
overview: From childhood to the presidency of Brazil, the documentary follows Jair Bolsonaro’s trajectory, tracing his background, military career, and the path that led to his political rise.

title: That Damned Thing
overview: A coroner’s inquest into an inexplicable death reveals the presence of an enigmatic creature.

title: Authentic Games - In the Disconnected Empire
overview: After years of ruling an offline world, the Disconnected Empire decides to take revenge. The Emperor plans to kidnap Marco Túlio, creator of Authentic Games, to bring joy to his dark kingdom. Upon entering this universe, Marco Túlio transforms into Authentic, a friendly character, and embarks on a great adventure to rescue the Craft Family and face the Empire. When all seems lost, unexpected help appears in the final confrontation.

title: Caterpillar
overview: Set in a run-down Wellington villa in 2003, CATERPILLAR follows three women living separate lives under one leaky roof. Sixteen-year-old Cassie is all bravado and vulnerability, drifting into risky territory as she searches for belonging. Her mother Maxine, 52, is a formidable single parent and filmmaker on the brink of a long-awaited breakthrough, finally offered a greenlight—if she can land a star. Holding everything together is Huia, Cassie’s grandmother, 80, whose life has been defined by quiet service to family and a private obsession with raising monarch caterpillars, dreaming of one day witnessing the legendary butterfly migration in Mexico.

title: Sattendru Maarudhu Vaanilai
overview: When a carefree orphan and a runaway minister's daughter marry on impulse, their love is tested by financial struggles and powerful enemies — from corrupt politicians to jealous rivals. Together, they uncover hidden truths and prove that love can survive even the darkest threats.

title: Pati Patni Aur Woh Do
overview: A seemingly perfect marriage in Prayagraj takes an unexpected turn when one decision leads to a chain of misunderstandings, suspicion, and comedic chaos.

title: Kartavya
overview: With his family's safety at stake and menacing threats closing in, a police officer must decide how far he'll go to uphold his duty.

title: Hayok
overview: A feisty thriller about a fiercely independent woman who becomes the obsession of a contractor desperate to possess her. But when betrayal turns violent, she strikes back with a revenge that destroys his pride and control.

title: The Crash
overview: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

title: Shera
overview: A high-energy action drama centered on strength, loyalty, and confrontation. The story unfolds through intense moments and gripping action as the protagonist faces powerful forces and personal challenges.

title: Angkinin Mo Ako
overview: Cess Garcia and VMX’s next big thing Dara Lima star in a steamy drama about two sisters and the man who sparks their sensual awakening. A female lawyer hires a young man as tutor for her younger sister but unknown to her, their review sessions are becoming wild

title: Bride of the Year
overview: When Lienkie's dream of budding a family of her own come crashing down, she hatches a devious plan to win "Bride of the Year" and get back at her ex.

title: Saptadingar Guptodhon
overview: Subarna Sen, along with Abir and Jhinuk, go on a dangerous treasure hunt in the Sundarbans. The trio seeks the legendary treasure of Raja Pratapaditya, facing increased risks in a new adventure that blends history, folklore, and suspense

title: Aakhri Sawal
overview: Vicky, a brilliant but volatile scholar who ignites a national firestorm when he publicly accuses his legendary mentor, Professor Gopal Nadkarni, of institutional bias. What begins as a faculty dispute is quickly hijacked by a sensationalist news anchor and an ambitious political activist, turning a private disagreement into a televised "intellectual trial" watched by millions.

title: 500 Miles
overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

title: Patlabor EZY: File 1
overview: Patlabor EZY File 1 is the first of a 3-part theatrical series taking place in 2036, 38 years after the events of Patlabor on Television and The New Files.

title: LifeHack
overview: Four teenage slackers attempt a multi-million-dollar Bitcoin heist from their bedrooms, only to spiral into the darkest corners of the internet-and a danger beyond their computer screens.

title: Fight Dirty
overview: When wealthy Queen Bee Kenzie makes a deal with high school bad boy Clay to be her fake boyfriend and bodyguard, she unknowingly steps into his dangerous world of illegal underground fighting - quickly igniting an undeniable attraction.

title: Call of My Life
overview: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.

title: Forge
overview: In Miami, siblings Raymond and Coco Zhang’s art forgery ring flourishes when they encounter a disgraced millionaire in need of their expertise. Meanwhile, FBI Art Crimes agent Emily Lee moves to Miami to investigate a series of mysterious paintings.

title: Gregg Allman: The Music of My Soul
overview: This visionary music documentary traces the turbulent, transcendent life of Gregg Allman — from a childhood ruptured by his father’s murder to the soulful emergence that reshaped American music. Through archival recordings, candid interviews, and electric performances, the film follows Gregg’s musical awakening amid the blues he worshipped, the creation of the Allman Brothers Band with his brother.

title: Magic Hour
overview: Erin and Charlie escape to the desert to navigate an unexpected and challenging new phase of their relationship.

title: Tokyo In 33 RPM
overview: A musical journey through Tokyo's Jazz Cafes.

title: Chaser Game W: A Match Made in Heaven
overview: Seven years after the events of “Chaser Game W2: The Beautiful Celestial Maidens”—Itsuki and Fuyu now live in Ito City, Shizuoka Prefecture, with their daughter Tsuki, who is in middle school. Amid their busy daily lives filled with housework, parenting, and work, the time they spend together has gradually become something they take for granted. Over the course of those seven years, their relationship has shifted from “lovers” to “family,” and subtle emotional distance has begun to emerge between them. Though their hearts are shaken by each other’s casual words and actions, they continue to maintain the appearance of a peaceful household. However, their daughter Tsuki senses the growing unease between her parents. One day, after getting caught up in trouble, Tsuki is helped by a taxi driver named Kozue. This encounter becomes a turning point, prompting Itsuki and Fuyu to finally confront their true feelings and reexamine the form their love has taken as it drifted apart.

title: 8v40
overview: A quirky, unlucky-in-love bachelor volunteers for a secret teleportation experiment, only to find himself transported across the world to the Philippines, where he accidentally disrupts the life of a woman he's been trying to woo online.

title: Club Kid
overview: A washed-up underground party promoter's life takes an unexpected turn when he is forced to care for a son he never knew he had.

title: THE A-CARE -Disusebody-
overview: At the "Ijinzaka Clinic" day service, a revolutionary treatment devised by Director Urushihara is secretly spreading among the elderly. Aiming for the ultimate cost-effective care, the amputation of "Disusebody" (limbs with no hope of recovery) has reportedly led to unexpected positive side effects, such as patients feeling "lighter in body and mind" or "developing a gentler personality." Yagura, an editor who hears these rumors, senses a potential revolution in geriatric medicine and proposes a book deal to Urushihara. However, an internal whistleblower leak about the daycare center soon surfaces in a weekly magazine. Following a shocking incident at a patient's home, everything begins to spiral into darkness.

title: Atonement
overview: Based on Dexter Filkins’ resonant New Yorker article of the same name, about Marine Lu Lobello, haunted by memories of a deadly incident in Baghdad, whose journey of guilt and remorse leads him to reach out to Nora, the sole surviving member of the family he believes he may have harmed.

title: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
overview: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

title: Chasing Utopia
overview: Chasing Utopia is a feature documentary asking the question everyone should be asking: will AI be humanity's greatest achievement or its greatest downfall? Mo Gawdat spent two years travelling the world - from Shanghai to Riyadh, New York to London - to find out, engaging with the leading minds shaping our future including Yoshua Bengio, Fei-Fei Li, Geoffrey Hinton, Max Tegmark, Elon Musk and Sam Altman. The result is a film that might change the way you see everything

title: Chandarege Wife
overview: 'Chandarege Wife' is a Sinhala drama focusing on a wife trying to sustain her marriage to a filmmaker while facing hidden truths and a crumbling relationship.

title: A Man and A Woman
overview: In the early spring of 2021, a man and a woman flew to Hong Kong at the same time, and while waiting to enter the mainland, they stayed in the same hotel, separated by a wall. During the short intersection of their lives, the two confided in each other about the pressure they were burdened with and found a spiritual harbor in Hong Kong, where tenacious vitality was blooming. And before the answer is revealed, the choice stops abruptly.

title: Paper Tiger
overview: Two brothers chase the American dream, but soon find themselves in the brutal world of violence and corruption of the Russian mafia.

title: The Beloved
overview: The acclaimed film director Esteban Martínez is a legend both for his films and for his past marked by violence and excess. For his new project, he offers his daughter Emilia a role under the pretext of helping her with her stalled acting career. Living together on set will foster a closeness they haven’t shared for years, but it will also reopen old wounds that never healed.

title: Precious Thing
overview: A daughter discusses the overlapping issues with her current life and her mother's previous and current experiences through phone calls over the course of many months while away at college. Life events cause conversations to get more serious and pressing, beginning to affect both women's lives as they cling to each other for comfort and consistency.

title: Full Phil
overview: Philip Doom, a wealthy American industrialist who attempts to reconnect with his daughter Madeleine during a luxurious trip to Paris. Unfortunately, French cuisine, a 1950s horror film and an intrusive hotel employee disrupt the smooth running of their stay.

title: STRAIGHT EDGE
overview: Desperate to escape his dead-end life, Matt (Chris Lovejoy) recruits his derelict friends to rob the neighborhood mob's card game. With his crew's reputation on the line, Denicio (Joe Graziano) is tasked with hunting down the trio and finding the money. Matt is forced to choose between his past or a life with the woman he loves.

title: Signs of Mr. Plum
overview: Contrary to his family’s expectations and despite having lost one eye, Karol Śliwka leaves his rural home to study art in Warsaw. He decides to be a designer of graphic signs. He fills communist Poland with his works and defines the country’s visual landscape. His signs do not hang in galleries, but are present in Polish homes, in Polish streets, at institutions and workplaces. At the same time, he leads an ordinary family life, which he documents passionately over the years. This extremely gifted artist is still considered one of the greatest sign designers in the world.

title: Es frisst
overview: After a botched robbery, a young gangster couple takes a mother and her daughter hostage and ends up in a forgotten forest cemetery on the edge of a disused industrial estate.

title: Dora
overview: A family retreats to the seaside, far from the bustle of Seoul. Their daughter, Dora, suffers from a mysterious illness. Her discovery of love unleashes a force as powerful as it is dangerous, with far-reaching consequences for those around her…

title: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
overview: Profiles the double Oscar winner, who helmed some of the most well-respected movies of all time, via never-before-seen archive and contributions from leading film directors. Haunted by the shadow of his dismissive father and his puritan upbringing, Lean was married six times, and he created layered and complex narratives in his work while struggling to find connection and meaning in his personal life.

title: La Perra
overview: On a remote, wind-lashed island off the Chilean coast, Silvia earns her living harvesting  seaweed and shares a quiet life with her partner. When she adopts a stray puppy, Yuri, her days fill with joy, love, and a tenderness that stirs a long-suppressed longing for motherhood. But Yuri’s sudden disappearance reawakens a haunting childhood trauma, forcing Silvia to confront a past she has never truly left behind.

title: In Pieces: The Musical (A Staged Concert)
overview: Be the first to experience Joey Contreras' hit new musical In Pieces, filmed LIVE during its sold-out run at The Other Palace in London.  Written and composed by Fred Ebb Award and Jonathan Larson Grant Finalist, Joey Contreras, In Pieces is a bold, contemporary new musical featuring a pop-driven score that dives into echoes of love, loss, and self-discovery by weaving the romantic journeys of six characters across three chapters of life. As friends, family, and former lovers confront old wounds and unresolved feelings, will they learn to coexist with the joy and pain of the past?  In Pieces has become a global sensation with a massive social media fanbase, tens of millions of streams, and licensed productions internationally. NOW, you can experience the staged concert from home for a limited time only.

title: Pinay Kamasutra
overview: Hosted by Ataska, Pinay Kama Sutra returns for another sizzling volume as she explores fifteen daring positions inspired by iconic VMX movie moments. Get in rhythm, feel every move, and prepare for a hotter, sweatier experience.

title: Caravelle 114
overview: At the height of Brazil’s military dictatorship, a flight would change the fate of everyone on board. Among the passengers were a mother, her two young children, and militants from VAR-Palmares with a daring plan: to divert Flight 114 to Cuba.  Caravelle 114 reconstructs, in fiction, the events behind the hijacking that defied the Brazilian dictatorship.

title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
overview: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

title: That They May Be One
overview: Uncovers a remarkable story of God’s providence unfolding for more than a century. From the urgent prayers of St. Elena Guerra, which inspired Pope Leo XIII to consecrate the twentieth century to the Holy Spirit, to the dramatic outpouring of the Spirit in Topeka, the historic revival at Azusa Street, and the surprising awakening among Catholics at Duquesne University in 1967, a powerful thread emerges.

title: Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul
overview: At half-time in the 2005 champion league final Liverpool were 3-0 down. What happened next made football history -​ as players recall in this documentary.

title: Diamond
overview: Joe Diamond is out of time with a traumatic past and an uncanny ability to solve crimes, using wit and observation to peel back hidden truths.

title: Goodnight Lamby
overview: Three-year-old Zia searches for her missing stuffed Lamby through her father’s surreal sculpture-a vast world of oceans, caves, and outer space. Her quest becomes a journey of courage, wonder, and self-discovery.

title: W.E.B. Du Bois: Rebel With a Cause
overview: Explore the life and legacy of notable Black scholar and civil rights pioneer W.E.B. Du Bois. From his birth, just five years after the Emancipation Proclamation; to his death, on the eve of the March on Washington in 1963, his legacy as an activist continues to resonate today.

title: Sight Unseen
overview: Three siblings inherit their estranged father's rural cabin after his mysterious death. They slowly realize someone, or something, still lives there.

title: Tom Clancy's Jack Ryan: Ghost War
overview: Jack Ryan is reluctantly pulled back into espionage when an international covert mission unravels a deadly conspiracy. Racing against time, he joins CIA allies Mike November & James Greer and sharp MI6 officer Emma Marlowe to battle a rogue black-ops unit in a high-stakes, deeply personal fight.

title: Speed Demon
overview: Aboard a high-speed train, a Nun who lost her faith must perform her first Exorcism on a possessed passenger hellbent on crashing the runaway train.

title: Death Has No Master
overview: Caro travels to Venezuela to sell her late father’s cacao plantation, only to find the family mansion occupied by its former staff, who are determined to remain at all costs. As Caro takes justice into her own hands to claim the inheritance she believes is hers, she sets off a struggle that unearths the violence buried in the land and its memory.

title: Crossing A Dawn
overview: During a date, Xu Qiu and Chen Yuzhou's serendipitous encounter leads to repeatedly thwarted attempts at intimacy, yet a night of urban wonders gradually unveils their guarded emotions, culminating in an unforgettable love.

title: Be Yourself
overview: Wu Xiao Bei, a girl born in the 2000s, suffered from a sudden breakup. After falling out of love, she repeatedly jumped into madness and decadence and finally decided to fight back! Xiao Bei stumbled through the "12 things not to do after falling out of love": transform yourself, pretend to be rational, and deal with all kinds of people from the opposite sex... However, can this long list of tips for a lovelorn really lead her out of her heartbreak?

title: The Man I Love
overview: In late 1980s New York, a theater artist living with AIDS takes on one possibly last great role.

title: God of Mischief
overview: When a cheeky 10-year-old boy sets his sights on playing Loki in the school play, his over-the-top confidence costs him the role, but he hatches a mischievous plan to prove he's the real god of mischief after all.

title: Vanilla
overview: In the late 80s Mexico, a family made up of seven women from different generations and ideologies fights to save the house in which they live and which they are about to lose due to an outstanding debt. We see the story through the eyes of the youngest, Roberta (8), as she embarks on a journey of self-discovery, which impacts the rest of the family.

title: I See Buildings Fall Like Lightning
overview: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

title: Dernsie: The Amazing Life of Bruce Dern
overview: DERNSIE is an intimate portrait of Bruce Dern—tireless, uncompromising, and one of the last living legends of his generation—whose endurance has shaped both a turbulent life and one of Hollywood’s most enduring careers. A relentless runner on and off screen, Dern has outlasted the very industry that defined him.

title: Untether
overview: During a chance encounter with an old friend at a rave, Antonio is forced to confront the lingering trauma of sexual abuse, facing the ghosts of his past as he learns to accept human connection again.

title: The Mandalorian and Grogu
overview: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

title: Drishyam 3
overview: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice ?

title: Deool Band 2
overview: The story follows a farmer who decides to question and test his faith, setting off a journey filled with emotional and life-altering moments. At its core, the narrative centers on a woman who tirelessly struggles for her family, facing hardships with resilience, as her path ultimately leads her to confront the very idea of divine power

title: Passenger
overview: After a young couple witnesses a gruesome highway accident, they soon realize they did not leave the crash scene alone, as a demonic presence called the Passenger that won't stop until it claims them both turns their van life adventure into a nightmare.

title: I Love Boosters
overview: A group of shoplifters take aim at a cutthroat fashion maven by stealing from her stores and reselling them at a lower price — what they call 'fashion-forward philanthropy'.

title: Bogatyrs
overview: Ancient Rus. The hero Svyatogor defeated the evil Sorcerer who wanted to conquer Rus - to do this, he used magic to turn into a Dragon. Svyatogor hid three artifacts (the claw, eye, and vein of the Dragon) in the modern world so that evil would never return. But because of the schoolboy Vanya, the Sorcerer's beloved enters our time. She wants to find these artifacts, resurrect the Dragon, and bring her betrothed back to life. Together with two heroes from ancient Rus, Vanya must find the villain and prevent her from carrying out her plan.

title: Home Entertainment
overview: Florian and Marie want to spend a cozy evening on the sofa watching a movie. But that's more difficult than expected: the couple navigate through a digital world full of streaming portals, voucher codes, delivery service apps and broken remote controls and keep tripping over themselves in the process.

title: Kyle Larson vs. The Double
overview: Two-time NASCAR champion Kyle Larson attempts the notorious "Double," racing the Indianapolis 500 and the Coca-Cola 600 on the same day. With weather, exhaustion, and risk closing in, 1,100 miles offers a rare inside look at one of the toughest challenges in motorsports-and the man daring enough to take it on.

title: While the Sky is Watching
overview: Underground dancers — Alice, Arseny, Stepan, Timur, Kirill, Lyosha and Kristina — are engaged in free creativity. They dream of getting recognition, but staying true to themselves. One day they get a chance to turn the game around: take part in a big documentary project and a TV show. Everyone will have to answer the question of why they dance — for the sake of popularity or at the call of their hearts.

title: The Curse Of Black Pond
overview: A group of teenagers go to an old house on vacation with a big black pond, what they don't know is that a long time ago, a witch was drowned and killed there and now she's back for revenge, on those who live in her house.

title: Home Not Alone 3
overview: Masha encounters the insidious Nanny again. But now the villain has a new ally - the charming swindler Anton. At stake is the school graduation! Together with her friend Yegor, Masha must stop the criminals and save the most important evening of the year.

title: Gudang Merica
overview: At the quiet Harapan Ayah Hospital, Razi blends in with three medical students undergoing their clinical rotations. What initially seems like routine night shifts gradually turns into a series of terrifying experiences after an unidentified patient dies under their care. Strange occurrences begin to emerge—shadows, unsettling sounds, and the presence of a horrifying figure. The situation reaches its peak when the patient’s body mysteriously disappears from their watch. Caught between medical logic and the fear of the unexplainable, they are forced to confront a mystery that slowly reveals a truth far greater than they ever imagined.

title: Stolen Kingdom
overview: A look into the underground community of rule-breakers at Walt Disney World in Orlando, Florida and how their actions led to the disappearance of an Audio-Animatronic named Buzzy.

title: Para Vigo Me Voy!
overview: A Documentary about the Brazilian Filmmaker Carlos Diegues and His Works.

title: Monument
overview: On America’s 250th anniversary, with attacks on libraries, archives, universities, and commemorative landmarks, the story of a nation’s history hangs in the balance. MONUMENT asks how looking and listening to one’s personal environment can help us understand our foundations. MONUMENT is centered on the history of Rhode Island, weaving statues, plaques, and place names together with the routine movements of everyday life.

title: A Machu Picchu Proposal
overview: Katie agrees to join her brother Dan and his girlfriend Luciana on a trip to Peru. Dan plans to propose to Luciana in a grand way at Machu Picchu at the end of the week and needs Katie’s Spanish speaking skills to ask Luciana’s Peruvian father for his blessing. However, when Luciana’s friend, Chef Carlos, arrives, he accidentally ruins each proposal attempt. Refusing to give up, Katie does everything in her power to make this proposal happen, until Dan calls it off. Katie must lean into Chef Carlos’ spontaneity to not only save the day and the proposal, and Carlos may just win Katie’s heart too!

title: Kamu Harus Mati
overview: Meta has been haunted by hallucinations since the death of her boyfriend. She feels terrorized by spirits, but her two best friends assume she's mentally ill, straining their relationship. As the terror intensifies and threatens her friends as well, Meta sets out to uncover the truth behind the events, even as she faces doubts about whether they're real or just hallucinations.

title: Bearcave
overview: Set in the Greek mountain village of Tirna, Bearcave follows Argyro, a badass farmer, and her best friend Anneta, the village "it" girl and local manicurist. Once Anneta admits that she's pregnant and planning to leave town with her lame cop boyfriend, Argyro challenges Anneta to embark on an adventure to find the mystical bear cave. Before Argyro has a chance to confess her own love, Anneta leaves for her new life in the big city. Argyro is left broken. Meanwhile, in her new home with her clingy mother-in-law, Anneta quickly realizes her destiny lies elsewhere.

title: The End of It
overview: In a near-future world where ageing can be cured and death is now optional, Claire, a former provocative artist approaching her 250th birthday, decides she’s had enough, she wants to die.

title: Quem Tem com Que Me Pague, Não Me Deve Nada
Nothing Between Us
overview: Living in Mexico City, Guillermo and Mechi, in Buenos Aires, are separated by over 4,000 miles and their marriages, both having structured family lives. Working for the same multinational food manufacturer they meet by chance at a corporate offsite. The attraction between them proves immediate and irresistible. The sudden spark makes them face their own desires and changes them in deeper ways than they thought possible.

title: The Match
overview: Film reconstructs the historic match Argentina vs England at the 1986 FIFA World Cup quarter-finals, famously remembered for the the hand of God goal by Maradona. Also exploring the sporting, political, and cultural dimensions of the encounter, in the background of the recent deadly Falklands War between the two countries.

title: Ugly Story
overview: Follows a man who becomes obsessively attached to a girl in love with someone else, descending into a dark psychological state as he struggles with rejection, leading to dangerous consequences.

title: Ladies First
overview: An arrogant but charismatic ladies' man finds his life of money, power and casual flings upended when he wakes up in a parallel world dominated by women.

title: Chand Mera Dil
